body: DRAFT CODE REVIEW of the newly appeared untracked document/compiler.scala snapshot, read-only while the author still owns every path. No gate run. The code confirms four release blockers and three major type/identity gaps. B1 ROOT AND CONTAINMENT ARE MANUFACTURED: the input has only situation, summary, and causal attempts. Yet :485-497 creates a NarratedWorld root whenever any situation emits, and :569-599 creates a Story segment plus weight-1.0 containment for every emitted situation. Neither passes through Resolver, ClaimFamily, policy, a resolution record, or a gap. Therefore the required unresolved-root law cannot fire and the ADR prohibition on default root/containment is false in production. B2 TRAJECTORY ABSENCE ERASURE IS REACHED BY CONSTRUCTION: the slice has no entity or participant attempt at all, graph entities/participants stay empty (:481-482, :601-606), then :629 calls derive. Every multi-situation build therefore emits entityTurnover=0.0 from missing participant support; without accepted temporal edges it also emits Resolved(Unresolved). Validation accepts step completeness. This is not a future edge case. B3 PROVIDER CONTROLS EPISTEMIC STATUS: SituationProposal, StorySummaryProposal, and CausalProposal expose arbitrary EpistemicStatus (:20-36); materialize copies it into ClaimMeta (:418, :524, :556, :687-726), and every situation is placed in the synthesized root. A provider can mint HumanAdjudicated or StructurallyDerived status, or promote reported/believed content to root. Remove status from provider values or replace it with a restricted acquisition ADT; the compiler must derive ClaimMeta status and context from accepted typed evidence. B4 TARGET TYPING IS ERASED: ResolutionRecord[A] pairs A with an unindexed NarrativeCandidateAddress (:124-136), forcing wildcard branches that throw IllegalStateException at :395-399 and :501-504. Use family-specific records or a target type indexed by the value family so the impossible case is unrepresentable. NarrativeCompilation.build is also unchecked private[document] (:318-346) despite strong cross-field invariants; use a checked constructor that validates draft/ValidationOutcome/receipt/fingerprint agreement. M1 SUPPORT IDENTITY: fingerprint :868-899 omits policy, proposal receipts/findings, alternative values, gap evidence and upstreamClaims, and provenance. Same emitted graph plus the same generic gap reason but different scientific support hashes identically, contradicting ADR support identity. M2 PERMUTATION LAW IS NOT PROVED: canonicalBundle keys omit raw score, evidence, conflicts, prompt package, critic score/note/evidence, and calibration probability (:782-808). Equal sort keys preserve input order; calibrationFor uses first match, so duplicated/conflicting calibrations can change resolution under permutation. Reject conflicting duplicates or canonicalize on every semantically relevant field. M3 INPUT REFERENCE GATE IS PARTIAL: of validates evidence IDs and span upper bounds, but not Evidence.upstream claim ids, ConflictRef targets, CriticFinding string targets, task coherence for findings, or source code-point boundaries (:265-294). Use the source validation primitive and validate the complete declared reference universe. Also replace delimiter-based unversioned renderSituation/renderSummary/renderCausal (:849-866); provider text containing separators can collide. POSITIVE: the draft already enforces sentence-kind chart keys and exact chart sentence identity, closing C2. These are snapshot findings for early correction, not a candidate verdict.
